claim.text: The migration chain disables runtime table/column DML on organizations, projects, GSC connections/jobs/metrics during the cleanup barrier, blocks parent cascades, then restores those five tables' runtime DML after guards are removed without PUBLIC write ACLs. Credential and OAuth-state direct writes are outside this fence.
